name: Eleanor Philpott (Hamilton)
milestones: Married John Alexander Hamilton (m. 22 Jun 1795, Frederick County, MD)
sources: Hamilton family register (The Family of Francis Hamilton and Susan), in Bill Allen’s Further Research (February 2012)
notes: Daughter of Barton and Martha (Musgrove) Philpott of Frederick County, Maryland. In 1850 she was living in Greenville, Ohio, with her daughter Eliza C. Jarboe and grandchildren.
